description: Persistent memories. Agents with “persistent” memory read and write files here – across runs.
emptyText: Turn on a persistent memory for an agent in the editor under “Memory”, or let the memory assistant propose one.
nameHint: Letters, digits, spaces, _ . and -. Several agents can share a memory.
clearText: All files in “{{name}}” will be deleted. Agents then start without memories.

consents.title: Consents for shared workflows
consents.intro: Workflows that use one of your memory spaces need your consent for exactly their current content. A changed workflow needs a new consent.
consents.workflowHint: The consent also covers every workflow it starts, in their current versions.
consents.covers_one: A consent for “{{space}}” covers this workflow:
consents.covers_other: A consent for “{{space}}” covers these {{count}} workflows:
consents.exactly: It applies to exactly this content. If any of these workflows, or a tool or connection they use, changes later, you will be asked again.
consents.stale: Something changed since you reviewed it: a workflow, or a tool or connection it uses. Review it again and then allow it.
consents.none: You have not given any consent yet.
